# Ann's Private Cuts

> Full-service hair salon based in Austin, Texas. Walk in and you're family. Mrs. Ann and her team do cuts and tapers, silk presses, color, locs, braids and makeup, fast and with care, and the shelves carry the hard-to-find products you've been looking for.

- Phone: (512) 491-8730
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Manor, Hutto
- Google rating: 4.6 from 116 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/anns-private-cuts/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/anns-private-cuts/book.html

## Services
- Cuts & tapers: Tapered cuts, pixie tapers, short natural cuts, men's cuts and razor shaves, and kids' cuts. Tell Ann what you need, even without a photo, and she gets right to it.
- Silk press & relaxers: Smooth, swingy silk presses and straightening, plus relaxers and perms done with care.
- Color & highlights: All-over color, silver and gray blending, and highlights, toned and styled before you leave the chair.
- Locs: Starter locs and retwists, clipped, set and finished under the dryer.
- Braids & weaves: Braids and weaves for everyday, for the kids, or for the big day. Last-minute wedding request? We have made it work before.
- Lashes, makeup & skin: Lashes, makeup, facials, eyebrow tint and waxing, plus natural nails, with Mocca lip colors at the front counter.

## About
Ann's Private Cuts has been doing hair since 1997. Today you'll find us in the strip plaza at 11139 N Interstate Hwy 35, Suite 178, in North Austin, with plenty of parking right off the highway. Inside it's golden-yellow walls, an orange accent wall, black chairs and a row of dryers, and a front counter lined with makeup and hair care. Mrs. Ann and her team take every hair type: tapers and short cuts, silk presses, relaxers and perms, color, locs, braids and weaves, plus lashes, makeup and waxing. There's a mix of younger and longer-serving stylists, so there's someone for everybody, and clients mention stylists like Carol and Keyunce by name. Walk in and you'll often get a next-up spot; book ahead if your day is tight. Early birds can come in Saturdays from 6 AM. People talk about how it feels: greeted like family the first time, appointments kept on time, no over-booking and no drama, and the price explained before anyone starts. One client drove down from Dallas–Fort Worth and said she'd make the trip again, for the hair and for the hard-to-find products on the shelves.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome, and you'll usually be offered the next open chair. If you're on a schedule, call (512) 491-8730 or book online to hold a time. Saturday mornings start early, at 6 AM.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Thursday 9 AM to 6 PM, Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday 6 AM to 3 PM. We're closed Sunday and Monday. Hours can change around holidays, so call (512) 491-8730 if you're coming at the edges of the day.
- Q: What hair types do you work with?
  A: All of them. Natural hair, relaxed hair, locs, color-treated hair, short cuts and long styles, for women, men and kids.
- Q: Where are you in Austin?
  A: 11139 N Interstate Hwy 35, Suite 178, Austin, TX 78753, in the strip plaza on the IH-35 frontage road in North Austin. It's an easy drive from Pflugerville, Round Rock and Manor.
- Q: Do you sell hair products?
  A: Yes. We carry hair care like Dudley's and makeup from Mocca Makeup & Skincare, including some hard-to-find products. Ask the team what's right for your hair.
- Q: Can you do hair for a wedding or event?
  A: Yes. We've handled last-minute requests for weddings before. Call (512) 491-8730 as early as you can and we'll fit you in.
